title: Lewa Safari Marathon — official conservancy experience page (history, entry growth, portals)
claims: The race began in the year 2000 with 180 entries at its debut and has grown to just over 1,200 participants yearly.
Categories on the conservancy page: full marathon 42 km, half marathon 21 km, Executive Race 10 km and Junior Fun Run 5 km.
Two registration portals: www.lewasafarimarathon.com for international participants; www.lewasafarimarathon.co.ke for Kenyan and East African citizens and residents.
The conservancy is described as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in northern Kenya.
